title: Tradescantia pallida extract incorporated chitosan/pullulan intelligent biodegradable films: an eco-friendly packaging to preserve the freshness of chicken
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00349K, Paper
Open Access

Manjunath P. Eelager, Saraswati P. Masti, Suhasini Madihalli, Ravindra B. Chougale, Nagarjuna Prakash Dalbanjan, S. K. Praveen Kumar
An intelligent biodegradable chitosan/pullulan film infused with Tradescantia pallida extract enhances physicochemical stability and bioactivity, enabling chicken meat preservation for two days at room temperature without refrigeration.
